description:
Returns the current USD price, 24h % change, market cap, and 24h volume for any supported cryptocurrency. Supported: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, USDT, USDC, ADA, AVAX, DOGE, DOT, MATIC, LINK, LTC, ATOM, UNI, SUI, APT, NEAR, PEPE. Source: CoinGecko.
Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
name: get_crypto_price
title: Get Current Crypto Price
